pr_title: Tighten number constraint in consequences to verbatim-only
pr_description: One change, three locations: replace `"only cite numbers if the project context provides evidence for them"` with `"use numbers only when the project context provides them directly — do not calculate, derive, or estimate figures"` in the consequences field description (Lever + LeverCleaned) and system prompt section 2. This was the single highest-impact change across analyses 69-74. In #478, this same wording eliminated fabricated % claims from consequences (haiku 20→0). Everything else is left unchanged from the baseline (PR #358) to isolate this one variable.
